en.title: Book Title Catalog — Count Titles That Are Prefix of Another
en.description:
Given a list of book titles titles, count the ordered index pairs (i,j) such that i≠j and titles[i] is a prefix of titles[j]. Identical titles at different indices also count as prefixes.

Parts of the input protocol and constraints marked "site supplement" were compiled by this site and are not additional conditions of the original problem.
en.input: The first line contains n (1≤n≤200000), followed by n lines, each a non-empty title consisting only of lowercase English letters, with length 1..1000; the total length of all titles is ≤2×10^6. The character set and constraints are site supplements.
en.output: Output the number of ordered index pairs that satisfy the condition.
en.explanation: Process the input according to the rules above; see the accompanying editorial for the approach, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First pin down the problem's definitions of counting, paths, or splitting, then choose a suitable graph traversal, frequency count, or dynamic programming approach.
